newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Bowater raised to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bowater raised to outperform.

text.p: -- Bowater Inc's rating was raised by Morgan Stanley on Tuesday to an outperform from its prior rating of neutral.

-- Analyst Matthew Berler said in a research report: "With the latest pullback in Bowater's share price, earnings, and forward estimates, we now feel comfortable suggesting that investors begin to accumulate the shares."
-- "Now that prices of Bowater's core commodities have collapsed, and consensus estimates along with them, we doubt that there is much downside in the share price," he said.
